subject.title: [Feature]: Add image viewing in the webchat file viewer.

question: Should the Control UI preview supported regular workspace image files in the existing lightbox, and which authorization, MIME-type, and size boundary should govern that preview?
rationale: The issue demonstrates a real UX gap, but the artifact viewer's authorization model does not establish the contract for arbitrary regular workspace files.

options.title: Add a bounded workspace-image preview
options.body: Route only explicitly supported, authorized workspace image files to the shared lightbox and keep the editor as the fallback for all other files.

options.title: Keep workspace files text-only
options.body: Retain the current file-browser behavior and document that image inspection is available only through session artifacts.

options.title: Design a broader file-preview contract first
options.body: Define a generic safe preview API for workspace files before adding image-specific UI behavior.

recommendation.title: Add a bounded workspace-image preview
recommendation.body: Route only explicitly supported, authorized workspace image files to the shared lightbox and keep the editor as the fallback for all other files.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently implemented the adjacent image-preview surface and investigated the remaining route distinction.
